editorial_checks: Real histories without invented scenes, dialogue or composite individuals. English is independently written, both Chinese scripts complete, and the front-end prose uses no SAE dimensional labels.

Antarctic wastewater is macerated but released untreated onto land before drainage to the sea. The report explicitly records responsible personnel's awareness that this does not comply with Annex III. Broadly positive findings do not erase the specific problem; no judicial judgment or later repair is invented.
The 12–15 December 2023 period is not called a three-day visit. Last inspection in 1995 is a coverage gap, not evidence of wrongdoing throughout the interval.

Designated observer eligibility, treaty access and the vessel/aircraft loading-location qualification are retained. Article IV protects positions; territorial claims are not said to have been abandoned.

French operational support and independently conducted Australian inspection/reporting are attributed to the report and 2024 meeting record. Neither dependence nor an assertion of independence alone proves influence absent or present.

Inspection, national implementation and separate dispute settlement are distinct. The absence of an observer's on-site enforcement budget is not generalized into the absence of all legal obligations or remedies. Non-mandatory checklists are not treaty obligations.
2012 snow, communication limits and unimplemented recommendations are attributed and limited. No particular station is accused of deliberate non-compliance without tracing its record.
Antarctic coverage ends with 2024 meeting follow-up to 2023 inspection. Renovation and treatment plans are not treated as evidence of later completion.

JCPOA Annex I paragraph 14 describes a 130-tonne needs estimate and export of excess; the number is not stripped of its wording or made an automatic termination trigger. November 2016 excess, reported shipment and destination verification are distinct.

The 10 January 2017 decision and end-January action precede the 19 February estimate submission. Uranium mass, UF6-equivalent limits and conditional accounting remain distinct; no operational treatment instructions are reproduced.

Implementation Day verifies Annex V preparatory measures, not a permanent historical or future clearance. Declared-material non-diversion is distinct from an ongoing assessment of absence of undeclared material/activity; an open assessment is not affirmative proof of hidden activity.

US May 2018 reasons and E3 responses are attributed contemporary positions, not interchangeable with Agency technical findings. Evidence constrains policy judgment without automatically selecting policy. No legal verdict on the entire withdrawal or later snapback is supplied.

2016 relief applies to specified nuclear-related measures, not all sanctions. IMF's 2017 banking evidence is limited and retrospective; legal permission, willingness to transact and household benefit are not equated.
JCPOA narrative stops in 2015–2018. No later events are used to confer foresight on contemporary participants, no present-day sanctions advice is offered, and no manuscript research file is changed.
